name: Solve analytic geometry and conic section problems
description: Users asked to solve coordinate geometry and analytic geometry problems, focusing on calculating distances, determining equations of circles, ellipses, and lines, and verifying properties of conic sections. Some requests involved proving theorems about intersecting circles or expressing coordinates of geometric centers in terms of algebraic parameters.
